name: Dell PowerEdge R6515
summary: 1U, one AMD EPYC, 10 x 2.5-inch drive bays, iDRAC9

scorm.title: Server build trainer: Dell PowerEdge R6515

lessons.title: Lab 1: Rack installation: find the U, fit the rails, lift and secure
Lab 2: Replace the processor, reusing its heat sink
Lab 3: Memory installation: choose a supported DDR4 model and populate A1 to A16
Lab 4: iDRAC setup: NOC check, monitor and keyboard, System Setup (F2), web check
Lab 5: RAM Distributor: DDR4 population and capacity planning
Lab 6: RAM Distributor Exam: random work-order check
